I am spending money on this game because I really love it. I like the story, but the content is lacking and translation errors are constant.

Especially considering the nature of the game genre and the importance of the story, translation issues are unacceptable.

A vicious cycle of the situation improving only to worsen again keeps repeating.

In this situation, the fact that I have to spend more money just to properly enjoy the game makes me question whether it is truly worth investing so much money in this game.

To be honest, I have been spending money hoping the company wouldn't go bankrupt because I liked the game's atmosphere, story, OST, illustrations, and concept so much.

However, having to spend money because of game balance issues is a completely different matter.

To be frank, I only spend about $80 to $100 a month, or at most $300, but if I had used that money to play other blockbuster games, I could have enjoyed them much more.

In other games, you can enjoy them without any problems just by pulling characters or weapons.

That is because the difficulty is set to that level in the first place.

Also, people sometimes invest more because doing so allows them to enjoy the content more easily and comfortably, or perhaps because they have an affection for the characters.

If the goal is to induce spending by increasing the game's difficulty,

I believe that rich and high-quality content should be provided to match.

I sincerely hope that this game succeeds and the company grows further so that we can enjoy the game with better quality and translation in the future.

Feelings can change, so let me present just facts. 

Level is inconsistent with Power. The Power of enemies both small and large in D-Tide are incongruent to those in typical modes. Let us take for example level 65 in Event and Normal D-Tide. 

Caraboo in Event is level 63, she has 52037 HP in bar one, she has 78056 in bar two. Caraboo cannot heal her health, and has a stage mechanic via the event to help you. This is a good challenge for new players, if difficult. 

Let's go to Normal in D-Zone. "Soul Reaper" GHelot in D-Zone is level 63. Her first bar is 234k. She heals at minimum once in it, and her second bar is 352k. The first Elite in **Nightmare mode** of W4 has comparable HP to **Normal mode boss "Soul Reaper."**

This is a boss that heals herself. She freezes cards. She has complete and total invulnerability on a hit post-rouse. She causes bleed. She has fervor too, so playing cards is bad for the majority of team compositions! 

Madness can remain as Madness is. But the HP values and attack values of bosses and smaller enemies for Normal, Hard and Nightmare **Must be adjusted** for this game mode. The jump from Normal to Hard is 10x or more hp, and from Hard to Nightmare is 3x. Nightmare W5 has over triple the HP of the highest A5W5 before and does not even have Ancient Embers to help you! 

At every level, these changes are disgusting, untested and uncared for. They absolutely must be fixed before next D-Tide or you will lose new and old players alike.

Rewards are insufficient, and cosmetics should not be locked behind Madness. Only Nightmare. Madness should be for leaderboard only. 

My genuine suggestion: Return to A1-A5, then add an A6 and an A7. You cannot balance Normal to Madness, you can't even balance Normal, so just go back to what works. Experiment with a new endgame mode instead of ruining this one!

Want to say that understandable that every gacha should run powercreep machine. Morimens make great work by make powercreep not so bad (even when we talk about doresain, invested doresain can clear previous w5A5 without red ring)
But this update not ever serve for powercreep. 
Example: Yes, e3 glotan can easily kill trash in w5 Madness  with full stall team while doresain struggle with it (because corrosion+own low dmg) and even when you farm evernight revel they can't help you because that's like tickling for w5 madness trash. 
But then we see boss ghelot.

You make not powercreep with this update, you make workable only some teams who can scale their damage very fast and strong OR have hp% damage. And there very limited pull of chars who can
-make damage in stall teams and scale fast
-not struggling because lvl mechanic
-not struggling because boss mechanic 

All this things together not make powercreep but just make gameplay limited by some list of awakeners and make already existed problem even worse.
Because only in w5 madness
-corrosion kill stealing 
-Caraboo missed chance
-Caraboo "sub-dps kit who anyway can't make real dps"
Feels even worse. 
You same time make limited pull of meta but chars who not suffering from gameplay decisions, have super fast scale and can scale in stall teams.

repost from old d-tide feedback:

the dtide update is a disaster on every level. there is absolutely nothing good i have to say about it.

madness dificulty:
i understand the logic of a dificulty exclusively for high spenders, regardless if i agree or not, it makes sense, it has a logic. where the logic ends is that not even whales can clear the nightmare mode. 6 hours in, there was 2 accounts able to clear a wave 4. not 200, not 20, only 2 accounts. the mode is so hard only a few comps can clear and even then it's too hard.  not even chinese community expected bosses that are this high hp 

lower dificulties:
the lowest dificulty is too hard.  the rewards distribution is straight up idiotic. the way rewards should be distributes sdhould've been account mats on lower difficulty so new players can farm them and grow the account, and luxury rewards(including silver) in higher difficulty for skilled players. what happened in reality was that important upgrade materials were put behind unreachable point thresholds. 

this ties into the next problem. light said that the dificulty will be toned down, closer to prior dtide system, and we get this update that messes everyone. it messes the new players the most, since it makes the game uncleareable and mats unreachable, it messes high spenders since most of their high invested comps don't clear, it messes casuals since every dificulty is way too hard...who was this made for? 

if anyone in the dev team reads this, nightmare mode should be heavily nerfed and replace madness. madness should be deleted completely. every pther dificulty should be nerfed. important units upgrade materials should be put behind lower difficulty clears, silver and any other materials that are luxuries should be put in higher difficulty.

i personally would like there to be 6 difficulties, easy normal hard challenge madness nightmare (nightmare being below madness makes no sense semantically) so that the difficulty curve is smoother, at the moment it often feels like the difficulty curve is so unsmooth that higher difficulties feel unattainable even if youre able to clear the one right below it

High wave Madness is just kind of unfun at the moment - the scaling between W1 to W5 is just too high.

As someone who does like to heavily invest into my pet comps, I had fun trying Nightmare W5 and Madness W1 with my Salvador and Pontos comps, but Madness W5 with Salvador was a 38 turn, 3 ECog exercise in frustration.

Worse still, despite this being a turn rewind shilling mode, turn rewind shuts off 25 turns in, so the feature doesn't even help past a certain point!

In addition to that, Replays also stop working at the 25 turn mark, which means that you can't show off the fun of playing your favourite comp at the highest difficulty even if you do manage to clear.

I think Madness tuning should have been a lot closer to current Nightmare - take the 10x step from Normal -> Hard down and adjust the rest down accordingly, and you'll have a smoother curve where people won't be forced to rely on things like Lotan OE or Vortice Spam.

Adding a separate difficulty for mega whales to flex in the leaderboard is probably fine. Some players are worried about it, because in the previous system most "well built" f2p and low spending accounts could clear A5 and normalizing them not being able to clear the highest difficulty definitely opens the door for future player abuse. I really want to trust that the developers genuinely want to make the game better and more enjoyable, even if the recent decisions aren't making it easy. 

I don't even mind locking an extra 1000 silver behind it, as long as it is actually a bonus and not taken from other rewards or gift codes (which hopefully won't be an issue, as it's pretty clear that only mega whales can clear it and giving them an extra 10 free pulls per month is going to have a negligible effect on players that pull every unit to OE or +12)

The difficulty gap between Normal and Hard difficulties and reaching 400 points becoming way too difficult are definitely the biggest problems, but I feel like one point most people are too focused on the former two to notice (and justly so, in my opinion), is that the changes don't even achieve the stated goal of giving mega whales a playing ground. The best DPS is regular Lotan because of her repeatable %HP damage. The best way to deal with the incoming damage is by cheesing death resist with Faint or Celeste and the like. While some limited units have similar mechanics, like gDoll and Tawil, most of them don't, forcing players to use very specific teams that can abuse very specific mechanics that let them deal with the massive health and damage, leaving most of the roster in the dust. 

While I have no doubt that HP damage, DR farming and revives will all be obliterated by Arc 3 rules, that just raises the question of why you'd add these changes when the game can't support them yet. If this update released in Arc 3, presumably with these mechanics gone, the number bloat wouldn't need to be big enough to account for them.
